data.name: Javeed
data.gender_notes: Javeed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Javeed is derived from the Arabic word 'javid' which means 'precious', 'valuable' or 'jewel'. The name Javeed carries the meaning “Jewel, Precious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Javeed usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner worth and value of a person.
data.etymology: Javeed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Javeed total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
